invariants.rationale: Since the method always throws an exception and never assigns a return value, result is never set and remains null at all exits.
Because the method always throws, no reachable program state will provide any value for result; this is trivially true, but uses a logical form.
Since the method throws immediately, any values or methods on extraMetadata are not used, so such preconditions are irrelevant.
All method arguments are unused as the method throws immediately, so invariants involving their usage are trivial at this point.
The method body always throws an exception; any invariant is trivially true at method exit because the return is never reached.
